items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that could lead to unauthenticated customer account takeover. Exploitation attempts have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce that enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API that lets unauthenticated attackers upload executable files to any store using a polyglot to bypass validation. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9.
